steps.instruction: Open creative inventory and verify OrangeSunshine item tab appears; screenshot item icons for key entries (leafs, raw materials, fluids, tools).
Spawn or place one of each plant seed and verify mature growth models on stage changes (Cannabis, Tobacco, Peyote, Coca, Coffea, Hops).
Place Mortar & Pestle, Drying Table, Mixing Table, Distillery, and Mash Tub. Check block and entity renderers, particle effects, and collision bounds.
Fill glass bottles/chalices with a few fluids and open Distillery/Mixing screens to confirm texture/model correctness.
Use /drug command to apply a known effect in creative test world and confirm overlay/visual warping behaves expectedly.
